scientific_background_not_used_as_design.observation: The NfL-related fragment migrates at roughly 25-35 kDa under non-reducing conditions and roughly 6-12 kDa after DTT reduction.
scientific_background_not_used_as_design.preferred_biochemical_model: Two Cys322-Cys322 disulfide-linked dimers associate as an antiparallel, staggered tetramer through a coiled-coil interface involving a hydrophobic core, electrostatic interactions, and geometric/conformational complementarity.
scientific_background_not_used_as_design.alternative_not_excluded: A disulfide-linked NfL dimer plus an unknown binding partner can also explain the apparent mass shift.
scientific_background_not_used_as_design.evidence_boundary: The DTT response supports an important disulfide contribution but does not alone establish tetramer stoichiometry or a purely hydrophobic dimer-dimer interface.
scientific_background_not_used_as_design.design_consequence: None in this campaign: the antibody design target is a single-chain monomer surface and no cysteine contact is requested.

excluded_from_campaign.conformation: any antigen oligomer, including covalently linked states
excluded_from_campaign.reason: The campaign owner selected a monomer-only design scope.
excluded_from_campaign.scientific_limitation: Monomer-only results cannot distinguish the preferred two-disulfide-dimer tetramer from a dimer-plus-partner model, establish oligomer stoichiometry, or predict epitope geometry in the observed non-reducing complex.

ranking_rule: All generated candidates and scores belong to the single-chain monomer track only; no dimer comparison or cross-conformation ranking is performed.
